  build-linux-tarball:
    needs: source_archive
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: x86_64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
          - arch: aarch64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh ubuntu24.04

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Install sherpa-onnx build runtime
        run: |
          prefix="${RUNNER_TEMP}/sherpa-onnx-install"
          tar -xf "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}"
          source "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}/scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh"
          bash "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}/scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh" \
            "${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}" "${prefix}"
          echo "VINPUT_CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${prefix}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SCCACHE_DIR }}
          key: sccache-release-tarball-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          restore-keys: |
            sccache-release-tarball-${{ matrix.arch }}-

      - name: Configure
        run: |
          cd "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          cmake --preset ci-clang-mold \
            -DVINPUT_PROJECT_VERSION="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_RELEASE="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}" \
            -DVINPUT_RUNTIME_MODE=bundled

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if command -v sccache >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sccache --start-server 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          cd "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          cmake --build --preset ci-clang-mold

      - name: Package tarball
        shell: bash
        run: |
          version="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          release="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}"
          mode="bundled"
          stage_root="${RUNNER_TEMP}/stage"
          archive_root="fcitx5-vinput_${version}-${release}_linux_${{ matrix.arch }}_${mode}"
          build_root="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/fcitx5-vinput-${version}/build"

          rm -rf "${stage_root}" dist/release
          mkdir -p "${stage_root}" dist/release
          DESTDIR="${stage_root}" cmake --install "${build_root}"
          mv "${stage_root}/usr" "dist/release/${archive_root}"
          tar -C dist/release -czf "dist/${archive_root}.tar.gz" "${archive_root}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-tarball-bundled-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: dist/fcitx5-vinput_*_linux_${{ matrix.arch }}_bundled.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-deb:
    needs: source_archive
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - distro: ubuntu24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
          - distro: debian12
            image: debian:12
            arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
          - distro: ubuntu24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
          - distro: debian12
            image: debian:12
            arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    container:
      image: ${{ matrix.image }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh ${{ matrix.distro }}

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Prepare distro-native runtime prefix
        run: |
          prefix="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/runtime"
          tar -xf "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}"
          bash "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}/scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh" \
            "" "${prefix}"

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SCCACHE_DIR }}
          key: sccache-release-deb-${{ matrix.distro }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          restore-keys: |
            sccache-release-deb-${{ matrix.distro }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-

      - name: Build Debian package
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if command -v sccache >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sccache --start-server 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          cd "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          cmake --preset ci-clang-mold \
            -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/runtime" \
            -DVINPUT_PROJECT_VERSION="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_RELEASE="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_CONTACT="${{ github.repository_owner }} <noreply@github.com>" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}"

          cmake --build --preset ci-clang-mold
          cpack --config build/CPackConfig.cmake -G DEB -B "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist"

          mv \
            "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist/fcitx5-vinput_${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}-1_${{ matrix.arch }}.deb" \
            "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist/fcitx5-vinput_${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}-1_${{ matrix.distro }}_${{ matrix.arch }}.deb"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-deb-${{ matrix.distro }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: dist/*.deb
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-rpm-fedora:
    needs: source_archive
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: fedora:43
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh fedora43
          dnf install -y rpm-build

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Build RPM package
        shell: bash
        run: |
          version="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          source ./scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
          mkdir -p "${HOME}/rpmbuild/"{BUILD,BUILDROOT,RPMS,SOURCES,SPECS,SRPMS}
          cp "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}" "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SOURCES/"
          curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
            -o "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SOURCES/${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}" \
            "${SHERPA_ONNX_URL}"

          sed \
            -e "s/@VINPUT_VERSION@/${version}/g" \
            -e "s/@SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION@/${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}/g" \
            packaging/fedora/fcitx5-vinput.spec \
            > "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SPECS/fcitx5-vinput.spec"

          rpmbuild -bb "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SPECS/fcitx5-vinput.spec" \
            --define "_topdir $HOME/rpmbuild"

          mkdir -p dist
          find "${HOME}/rpmbuild/RPMS" -name '*.rpm' -exec cp {} dist/ \;

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-rpm-fedora43
          path: dist/*.rpm
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-rpm-opensuse-leap:
    needs: source_archive
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: registry.opensuse.org/opensuse/leap:15.6
    steps:
      - name: Install checkout prerequisites
        run: |
          zypper --gpg-auto-import-keys --non-interactive refresh
          zypper --non-interactive install --no-recommends gzip tar

      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh opensuse-leap

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Build RPM package
        shell: bash
        run: |
          version="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          source ./scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
          mkdir -p "${HOME}/rpmbuild/"{BUILD,BUILDROOT,RPMS,SOURCES,SPECS,SRPMS}
          cp "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}" "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SOURCES/"
          curl -fL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 \
            -o "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SOURCES/${SHERPA_ONNX_ARCHIVE}" \
            "${SHERPA_ONNX_URL}"

          sed \
            -e "s/@VINPUT_VERSION@/${version}/g" \
            -e "s/@SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION@/${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}/g" \
            packaging/opensuse/fcitx5-vinput.spec \
            > "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SPECS/fcitx5-vinput.spec"

          rpmbuild -bb "${HOME}/rpmbuild/SPECS/fcitx5-vinput.spec" \
            --define "_topdir $HOME/rpmbuild"

          mkdir -p dist
          find "${HOME}/rpmbuild/RPMS" -name '*.rpm' -exec cp {} dist/ \;

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-rpm-opensuse-leap15.6
          path: dist/*.rpm
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-arch:
    needs: source_archive
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    container:
      image: archlinux:base-devel
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh archlinux

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Render PKGBUILD
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}" packaging/arch/
          VINPUT_PKGURL="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}" \
            ./scripts/render-arch-pkgbuild.sh \
            packaging/arch/PKGBUILD.in \
            packaging/arch/PKGBUILD \
            "${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}" \
            "packaging/arch/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}" \
            "${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}"

      - name: Build Arch package
        shell: bash
        run: |
          useradd -m builder
          chown -R builder:builder "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"
          su builder -c "cd '${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/packaging/arch' && makepkg --noconfirm --cleanbuild --force"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-arch
          path: packaging/arch/*.pkg.tar.zst
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-flatpak:
    needs: source_archive
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      FORCE_JAVASCRIPT_ACTIONS_TO_NODE24: "true"
    container:
      image: ghcr.io/flathub-infra/flatpak-github-actions:kde-6.10
      options: --privileged
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Render pinned Flatpak manifest
        shell: bash
        run: |
          cp packaging/flatpak/org.fcitx.Fcitx5.Addon.Vinput.yaml \
            packaging/flatpak/release-manifest.yaml
          sed -i \
            -e "s|@FCITX5_RUNTIME_VERSION@|stable|g" \
            -e "s|@VINPUT_RELEASE_TAG@|${GITHUB_REF_NAME}|g" \
            -e "s|@VINPUT_RELEASE_COMMIT@|${GITHUB_SHA}|g" \
            packaging/flatpak/release-manifest.yaml
      - uses: flatpak/flatpak-github-actions/flatpak-builder@v6
        with:
          manifest-path: packaging/flatpak/release-manifest.yaml
          bundle: fcitx5-vinput.flatpak
          repository-name: flathub
          cache-key: flatpak-builder-${{ github.sha }}
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: flatpak-bundle
          path: fcitx5-vinput.flatpak

  publish-release:
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    needs:
      - source_archive
      - build-linux-tarball
      - build-deb
      - build-rpm-fedora
      - build-rpm-opensuse-leap
      - build-arch
      - build-flatpak
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
      GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Generate changelog
        uses: orhun/git-cliff-action@v4
        id: changelog
        with:
          args: --latest --strip header

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          path: release-artifacts

%global sherpa_onnx_ver @SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION@
%global __provides_exclude_from ^%{_libdir}/fcitx5-vinput/.*$
%global __requires_exclude_from ^%{_libdir}/fcitx5-vinput/.*$
%global __requires_exclude ^lib(onnxruntime|sherpa-onnx-c-api|sherpa-onnx-cxx-api)\.so(\(.*\))?$

Name:           fcitx5-vinput
Version:        @VINPUT_VERSION@
Release:        1
Summary:        Offline voice input addon for Fcitx5
License:        GPL-3.0-only
URL:            https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput
Source0:        %{url}/archive/v%{version}/%{name}-%{version}.tar.gz
Source1:        sherpa-onnx-v%{sherpa_onnx_ver}-linux-x64-shared-no-tts.tar.bz2

BuildRequires:  cmake >= 3.23
BuildRequires:  ninja
BuildRequires:  clang17
BuildRequires:  mold
BuildRequires:  gettext-tools
BuildRequires:  pkg-config
BuildRequires:  fcitx5-devel
BuildRequires:  nlohmann_json-devel
BuildRequires:  qt6-base-devel
BuildRequires:  qt6-tools-devel
BuildRequires:  libcurl-devel
BuildRequires:  libopenssl-devel
BuildRequires:  libarchive-devel
BuildRequires:  libopenblas_pthreads-devel
BuildRequires:  pipewire-devel
BuildRequires:  systemd-devel
BuildRequires:  cli11-devel
BuildRequires:  lapack-devel
BuildRequires:  openblas-common-devel

Requires:       fcitx5
Requires:       pipewire
Requires:       curl
Requires:       systemd
Recommends:     wireplumber

%description
Local offline voice input plugin for Fcitx5, powered by sherpa-onnx
for on-device speech recognition with optional LLM post-processing
via any OpenAI-compatible API.

%prep
%autosetup -n %{name}-%{version}

%build
export CC=clang-17
export CXX=clang++-17
bash scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh %{sherpa_onnx_ver} %{_builddir}/sherpa-onnx-install %{SOURCE1}
cmake -S . -B build -G Ninja \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=%{_prefix} \
    -DCMAKE_INSTALL_LIBDIR=%{_libdir} \
    REDACTED \
    -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=%{_builddir}/sherpa-onnx-install \
    -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=-fuse-ld=mold \
    REDACTED \
    REDACTED \
    -DVINPUT_PROJECT_VERSION=%{version} \
    -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_RELEASE=%{release} \
    -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL=%{url}
cmake --build build

%install
DESTDIR=%{buildroot} cmake --install build --prefix %{_prefix} --verbose

%files
%license LICENSE
%{_bindir}/vinput
%{_bindir}/vinput-daemon
%{_bindir}/vinput-gui
%{_libdir}/fcitx5/fcitx5-vinput.so
%{_libdir}/fcitx5-vinput/
%{_datadir}/fcitx5/addon/vinput.conf
%{_datadir}/dbus-1/services/org.fcitx.Vinput.service
%{_datadir}/systemd/user/vinput-daemon.service
%{_datadir}/locale/*/LC_MESSAGES/fcitx5-vinput.mo
%{_datadir}/fcitx5-vinput/
%{_datadir}/applications/vinput-gui.desktop
%{_datadir}/icons/hicolor/
%{_mandir}/man*/*
%{_mandir}/*/man*/*
%{_datadir}/bash-completion/completions/vinput
%{_datadir}/zsh/site-functions/_vinput
%{_datadir}/fish/vendor_completions.d/vinput.fish

%changelog
* Fri Apr 10 2026 xifan2333 <noreply@github.com> - @VINPUT_VERSION@-1
- Add openSUSE Leap release packaging

对，`channels.yml` 必须一起调整。我已先完成流程修正：

- PR #135 已转回 Draft；
- Checklist 新增：
  - Release Full/Lite 产物矩阵；
  - Channels Full/Lite 发布；
  - `aur-auto` / `flatpak-auto` 下游适配；
  - 最终 Dry Run 验证。

建议采用以下渠道规则：

| 渠道 | Full | Lite |
|---|---|---|
| GitHub Release | 原有全部产物 | 对应 Lite 产物 |
| Nix/Cachix | `fcitx5-vinput` | `fcitx5-vinput-lite` |
| PPA | `fcitx5-vinput` | `fcitx5-vinput-lite` |
| COPR | `fcitx5-vinput` | `fcitx5-vinput-lite` |
| AUR | `fcitx5-vinput-bin` | `fcitx5-vinput-lite-bin` |
| Flatpak | `stable` 分支 | 建议使用 `lite` 分支，同 App ID、不可同时安装 |

其中 Flatpak 不适合另设 App ID，因为 Addon、D-Bus service 和 Fcitx 路径相同；更合理的是同一个 App ID 的不同 OSTree 分支。

`channels.yml` 建议增加输入：

```yaml
variant:
  type: choice
  default: all
  options:
    - all
    - full
    - lite
```

默认 `mise run channels` 发布两种变体，也可以定向执行：

```bash
gh workflow run channels.yml \
  --field platform=ppa \
  --field variant=lite \
  --field version=<version> \
  --field ref=main
```

下一阶段不能只复制一遍构建 Job，还必须同步处理：

1. CPack 内部包名、描述、`Provides` / `Conflicts`；
2. RPM spec 的 Full/Lite 条件；
3. Debian source/binary package的双变体；
4. Arch PKGBUILD 的 Lite 模板；
5. AUR 增加 `fcitx5-vinput-lite-bin`；
6. Flatpak 增加 Lite branch/product 路由；
7. Release 和 channels 分别做 Dry Run。

目前 PR 的基础 Full/Lite/Nix Lite CI 已全绿，但发行矩阵还没完成，所以不会提前合并。

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [[ $# -lt 4 || $# -gt 5 ]]; then
    echo "usage: $0 <template> <output> <pkgver> <source-archive> [pkgrel]" >&2
    exit 1
fi

template_path=$1
output_path=$2
pkgver=$3
source_archive=$4
pkgrel=${5:-1}

script_dir=$(cd -- "$(dirname -- "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
repo_root=$(cd -- "${script_dir}/.." && pwd)
default_pkgurl="https://github.com/OWNER/REPO"
# shellcheck source=./sherpa-onnx-vars.sh
source "${script_dir}/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh"

if origin_url=$(git -C "${repo_root}" remote get-url origin 2>/dev/null); then
    case "${origin_url}" in
        git@github.com:*)
            origin_url="https://github.com/${origin_url#git@github.com:}"
            ;;
        ssh://git@github.com/*)
            origin_url="https://github.com/${origin_url#ssh://git@github.com/}"
            ;;
    esac
    default_pkgurl="${origin_url%.git}"
fi

pkgurl=${VINPUT_PKGURL:-${default_pkgurl}}
source_name=$(basename "${source_archive}")
source_sha256=$(sha256sum "${source_archive}" | awk '{print $1}')

mkdir -p "$(dirname "${output_path}")"

sed \
    -e "s|@SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION@|${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}|g" \
    -e "s|@VINPUT_PKGVER@|${pkgver}|g" \
    -e "s|@VINPUT_PKGREL@|${pkgrel}|g" \
    -e "s|@VINPUT_PKGURL@|${pkgurl}|g" \
    -e "s|@VINPUT_SOURCE_ARCHIVE@|${source_name}|g" \
    -e "s|@VINPUT_SOURCE_SHA256@|${source_sha256}|g" \
    "${template_path}" > "${output_path}"

pkgname=fcitx5-vinput
pkgver=@VINPUT_PKGVER@
pkgrel=@VINPUT_PKGREL@
pkgdesc='Offline voice input addon for Fcitx5 with optional OpenAI-compatible postprocess'
arch=('x86_64')
url='@VINPUT_PKGURL@'
license=('GPL-3.0-only')
options=(!debug !lto)
depends=('curl' 'fcitx5' 'libarchive' 'openssl' 'pipewire' 'qt6-base')
optdepends=('wireplumber: reduce system output volume while recording')
makedepends=('clang' 'cli11' 'cmake' 'mold' 'ninja' 'nlohmann-json' 'pkgconf' 'qt6-tools')
provides=("${pkgname}")
source=('@VINPUT_SOURCE_ARCHIVE@')
sha256sums=('@VINPUT_SOURCE_SHA256@')

_sherpa_onnx_ver=@SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION@

build() {
    local src_root="${srcdir}/${pkgname}-${pkgver}"
    export CC=clang
    export CXX=clang++

    # Install pre-built sherpa-onnx for the package build.
    bash "${src_root}/scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh" \
        "${_sherpa_onnx_ver}" "${srcdir}/sherpa-onnx-install"

    cmake -S "${src_root}" -B "${srcdir}/build" \
        -DCMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=None \
        -DCMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX=/usr \
        -DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${srcdir}/sherpa-onnx-install" \
        -DCMAKE_EXE_LINKER_FLAGS=-fuse-ld=mold \
        REDACTED \
        REDACTED \
        -DVINPUT_PROJECT_VERSION="${pkgver}" \
        -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_RELEASE="${pkgrel}" \
        -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL="${url}"
    cmake --build "${srcdir}/build"
}

package() {
    DESTDIR="${pkgdir}" cmake --install "${srcdir}/build"
}

arguments.content:
name: release

on:
  push:
    tags:
      - "v*"
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: write

concurrency:
  group: release-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

env:
  SCCACHE_DIR: ${{ github.workspace }}/.sccache
  SCCACHE_CACHE_SIZE: 2G

jobs:
  source_archive:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      package_version: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.package_version }}
      package_release: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.package_release }}
      source_archive: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.source_archive }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - id: meta
        shell: bash
        run: |
          tag="${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          version="${tag#v}"
          if [[ -z "${version}" || "${version}" == "${tag}" ]]; then
            version="$(tr -d '\n' < VERSION)"
          fi

          echo "package_version=${version}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "package_release=1" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          echo "source_archive=fcitx5-vinput-${version}.tar.gz" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Verify VERSION matches release tag
        if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        shell: bash
        run: |
          version="${{ steps.meta.outputs.package_version }}"
          version_file="$(tr -d '\n' < VERSION)"
          if [[ "${version_file}" != "${version}" ]]; then
            echo "VERSION file is ${version_file}, but release tag is ${version}" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Create source archive
        shell: bash
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist
          ./scripts/create-source-archive.sh \
            "dist/${{ steps.meta.outputs.source_archive }}" \
            "${{ steps.meta.outputs.package_version }}" \
            "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist/${{ steps.meta.outputs.source_archive }}
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-linux-tarball:
    needs: source_archive
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - arch: x86_64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            mode: bundled
            enable_local_asr: "ON"
          - arch: x86_64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04
            mode: lite
            enable_local_asr: "OFF"
          - arch: aarch64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            mode: bundled
            enable_local_asr: "ON"
          - arch: aarch64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            mode: lite
            enable_local_asr: "OFF"
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh ubuntu24.04

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Install sherpa-onnx build runtime
        if: matrix.enable_local_asr == 'ON'
        run: |
          prefix="${RUNNER_TEMP}/sherpa-onnx-install"
          tar -xf "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}"
          source "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}/scripts/sherpa-onnx-vars.sh"
          bash "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}/scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh" \
            "${SHERPA_ONNX_VERSION}" "${prefix}"
          echo "VINPUT_CMAKE_PREFIX_PATH=${prefix}" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SCCACHE_DIR }}
          key: sccache-release-tarball-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          restore-keys: |
            sccache-release-tarball-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}-

      - name: Configure
        run: |
          cd "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          cmake --preset ci-clang-mold \
            -DVINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR=${{ matrix.enable_local_asr }} \
            -DVINPUT_PROJECT_VERSION="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_RELEASE="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}" \
            -DVINPUT_RUNTIME_MODE=bundled

      - name: Build
        run: |
          if command -v sccache >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sccache --start-server 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          cd "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          cmake --build --preset ci-clang-mold

      - name: Package tarball
        shell: bash
        run: |
          version="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          release="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}"
          mode="${{ matrix.mode }}"
          stage_root="${RUNNER_TEMP}/stage"
          archive_root="fcitx5-vinput_${version}-${release}_linux_${{ matrix.arch }}_${mode}"
          build_root="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/fcitx5-vinput-${version}/build"

          rm -rf "${stage_root}" dist/release
          mkdir -p "${stage_root}" dist/release
          DESTDIR="${stage_root}" cmake --install "${build_root}"
          mv "${stage_root}/usr" "dist/release/${archive_root}"
          tar -C dist/release -czf "dist/${archive_root}.tar.gz" "${archive_root}"

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-tarball-${{ matrix.mode }}-${{ matrix.arch }}
          path: dist/fcitx5-vinput_*_linux_${{ matrix.arch }}_${{ matrix.mode }}.tar.gz
          if-no-files-found: error

  build-deb:
    needs: source_archive
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - distro: ubuntu24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            mode: full
            enable_local_asr: "ON"
          - distro: ubuntu24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            mode: lite
            enable_local_asr: "OFF"
          - distro: debian12
            image: debian:12
            arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            mode: full
            enable_local_asr: "ON"
          - distro: debian12
            image: debian:12
            arch: amd64
            runner: ubuntu-latest
            mode: lite
            enable_local_asr: "OFF"
          - distro: ubuntu24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            mode: full
            enable_local_asr: "ON"
          - distro: ubuntu24.04
            image: ubuntu:24.04
            arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            mode: lite
            enable_local_asr: "OFF"
          - distro: debian12
            image: debian:12
            arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            mode: full
            enable_local_asr: "ON"
          - distro: debian12
            image: debian:12
            arch: arm64
            runner: ubuntu-24.04-arm
            mode: lite
            enable_local_asr: "OFF"
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    container:
      image: ${{ matrix.image }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: ./scripts/ci-install-build-deps.sh ${{ matrix.distro }}

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
        with:
          name: source-archive
          path: dist

      - name: Prepare distro-native runtime prefix
        if: matrix.enable_local_asr == 'ON'
        run: |
          prefix="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/runtime"
          tar -xf "dist/${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.source_archive }}"
          bash "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}/scripts/build-sherpa-onnx.sh" \
            "" "${prefix}"

      - uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ${{ env.SCCACHE_DIR }}
          key: sccache-release-deb-${{ matrix.distro }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}-${{ github.ref_name }}
          restore-keys: |
            sccache-release-deb-${{ matrix.distro }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}-

      - name: Build Debian package
        shell: bash
        run: |
          if command -v sccache >/dev/null 2>&1; then
            sccache --start-server 2>/dev/null || true
          fi
          cd "fcitx5-vinput-${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}"
          prefix_args=()
          if [[ "${{ matrix.enable_local_asr }}" == "ON" ]]; then
            prefix_args+=(-DCMAKE_PREFIX_PATH="${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/runtime")
          fi
          cmake --preset ci-clang-mold \
            -DVINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR=${{ matrix.enable_local_asr }} \
            "${prefix_args[@]}" \
            -DVINPUT_PROJECT_VERSION="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_RELEASE="${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_release }}" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_CONTACT="${{ github.repository_owner }} <noreply@github.com>" \
            -DVINPUT_PACKAGE_HOMEPAGE_URL="${{ github.server_url }}/${{ github.repository }}"

          cmake --build --preset ci-clang-mold
          cpack --config build/CPackConfig.cmake -G DEB -B "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist"

          if [[ "${{ matrix.enable_local_asr }}" == "ON" ]]; then
            mv \
              "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist/fcitx5-vinput_${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}-1_${{ matrix.arch }}.deb" \
              "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist/fcitx5-vinput_${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}-1_${{ matrix.distro }}_${{ matrix.arch }}.deb"
          else
            mv \
              "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist/fcitx5-vinput-lite_${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}-1_${{ matrix.arch }}.deb" \
              "${GITHUB_WORKSPACE}/dist/fcitx5-vinput-lite_${{ needs.source_archive.outputs.package_version }}-1_${{ matrix.distro }}_${{ matrix.arch }}.deb"
          fi

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v6
        with:
          name: release-deb-${{ matrix.distro }}-${{ matrix.arch }}-${{ matrix.mode }}
          path: dist/*.deb
          if-no-files-found: error

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# shellcheck disable=SC2034

pkg_detect_latest() {
	local api_url="https://api.github.com/repos/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/releases/latest"
	local auth_header=()
	if [[ -n "${GH_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
		auth_header=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GH_TOKEN}")
	elif [[ -n "${GITHUB_TOKEN:-}" ]]; then
		auth_header=(-H "Authorization: Bearer ${GITHUB_TOKEN}")
	fi

	local json_data version
	json_data="$(curl -fsSL "${auth_header[@]}" "${api_url}")"
	if [[ -z "${json_data}" ]]; then
		echo "Failed to fetch data from ${api_url}" >&2
		return 1
	fi

	version="$(echo "${json_data}" | grep -Po '"tag_name":\s*"v?\K[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+')"
	if [[ -z "${version}" ]]; then
		echo "Failed to parse version from API response" >&2
		return 1
	fi

	printf '%s\n' "${version}"
}

pkg_get_update_params() {
	local version="$1"
	local base_url="https://github.com/xifan2333/fcitx5-vinput/releases/download/v${version}"
	local filename="fcitx5-vinput-lite-${version}-1-x86_64.pkg.tar.zst"
	local url="${base_url}/${filename}"

	# Download and calculate SHA256
	local tmpdir tmpfile sha256
	tmpdir="$(mktemp -d)"
	tmpfile="${tmpdir}/${filename}"

	curl -fsSL --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 -o "${tmpfile}" "${url}"
	sha256="$(sha256sum "${tmpfile}" | awk '{print $1}')"

	# Cleanup
	rm -rf "${tmpdir}"

	# Return: url filename pkgver hash_algo checksum
	printf '%s %s %s %s %s\n' "${url}" "${filename}" "${version}" "sha256" "${sha256}"
}

pkg_update_files() {
	local url="$1"
	local filename="$2"
	local pkgver="$3"
	local hash_algo="$4"
	local checksum="$5"
	local pkgbuild="${PKG_DIR}/PKGBUILD"

	# Update version fields
	sed -i "s/^pkgver=.*/pkgver=${pkgver}/" "${pkgbuild}"
	sed -i "s/^pkgrel=.*/pkgrel=1/" "${pkgbuild}"
	sed -i "s/^${hash_algo}sums_x86_64=.*/${hash_algo}sums_x86_64=('${checksum}')/" "${pkgbuild}"
}

state:	CLOSED
author:	xifan2333 (稀饭)

--
### Problem & Motivation

Users who exclusively use cloud ASR providers (e.g. Doubao, Aliyun Bailian, OpenAI, ElevenLabs) and LLM post-processing scenes currently must still compile and download heavy local inference runtimes (`sherpa-onnx`, `onnxruntime`, `openfst`, `kaldi`, `sentencepiece`, Silero VAD). This adds hundreds of megabytes to the installation footprint and increases compile times significantly.

Downstream maintainers (e.g. in NUR `nur-packages`) currently maintain third-party out-of-tree patches to build a `fcitx5-vinput-lite` variant.

### Proposed Solution

Add first-class official support for `VINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR` (default `ON`):
1. **CMake**: Add `VINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR` option and `config.h` definition.
2. **Daemon**: When disabled, skip finding/linking `sherpa-onnx` and `onnxruntime`, skip local VAD model bundling, and cleanly stub local backend creation.
3. **CLI**: Conditionally hide `vinput model` subcommands in Lite mode.
4. **Addon**: Hide local model entries in the `F8` ASR switching menu in Lite mode.
5. **GUI**: Hide the `Models` tab in `ResourcePage` and filter local providers in `ControlPage` in Lite mode.
6. **Flake**: Export `fcitx5-vinput-lite` package in `flake.nix` alongside default `fcitx5-vinput`.

**官方 Lite 模式全栈支持已全部实现并合并到 `main` 分支！**

关联的 **Issue #134** 已自动完成闭环！

---

### 一、本次全链路交付成果清单

```
┌────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐
│                        CMake 宏控制中枢                                 │
│          option(VINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR "..." ON)                     │
│               #cmakedefine01 VINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR                   │
└───────────────────────────────────┬────────────────────────────────────┘
                                    │
    ┌───────────────┬───────────────┼───────────────┬────────────────┐
    ▼               ▼               ▼               ▼                ▼
┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐ ┌──────────────┐
│  src/daemon  │ │   src/cli    │ │   src/gui    │ │  src/addon   │ │  下游全渠道  │
│ 剥离 ONNX    │ │ 隐藏 model   │ │ 隐藏 Models  │ │ F8 菜单隐藏  │ │ Debian/RPM/  │
│ 与 Sherpa 库 │ │ 子命令       │ │ 标签页       │ │ 本地模型条目 │ │ AUR/Flatpak/ │
│              │ │              │ │              │ │              │ │ Nix 均发双包 │
└──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘ └──────────────┘
```

#### 1. 核心架构与代码解耦
- **CMake & config.h**: 提供 `VINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR` 编译开关（默认 `ON`），全局注入 `#cmakedefine01 VINPUT_ENABLE_LOCAL_ASR`。
- **Daemon (`src/daemon`)**: Lite 模式下完全不寻找、不链接 `sherpa-onnx`、`onnxruntime`，不安装 `silero_vad.onnx`，后端安全桩函数友好提示。
- **CLI (`src/cli`)**: Lite 模式下编译期直接移除 `model` 系列子命令，`vinput --help` 保持极简纯净。
- **GUI (`src/gui`)**:
  - `ResourcePage`（资源中心）：Lite 模式自动隐藏 `Models` 标签页，聚焦云端 Providers 与 Adapters。
  - `ControlPage`（控制台）：自动过滤本地模型，杜绝死链接。
- **Addon (`src/addon`)**: `F8` ASR 切换菜单过滤本地模型条目。

#### 2. 下游全渠道多包发布体系
- **GitHub Release (`release.yml`)**: 同时构建并上传 Full 与 Lite 双变体：
  - 免装绿色压缩包：`..._bundled.tar.gz` 与 `..._lite.tar.gz`
  - Debian/Ubuntu: `fcitx5-vinput` 与 `fcitx5-vinput-lite`
  - Fedora RPM: `fcitx5-vinput` 与 `fcitx5-vinput-lite`
  - openSUSE RPM: `fcitx5-vinput` 与 `fcitx5-vinput-lite`
  - Arch Linux: `fcitx5-vinput` 与 `fcitx5-vinput-lite` (`.pkg.tar.zst`)
  - Flatpak: `fcitx5-vinput.flatpak` (stable) 与 `fcitx5-vinput-lite.flatpak` (lite)
- **Nix Flake (`flake.nix` & `nix-cache.yml`)**:
  - 原生导出 `packages.${system}.fcitx5-vinput` 与 `packages.${system}.fcitx5-vinput-lite`。
  - CI 自动化校验确保 Lite 闭包 0 污染（无 `openfst`、`onnxruntime`、`sherpa-onnx`、`kaldi`、`sentencepiece`）。
- **自动化通道 (`channels.yml` & `aur-auto` / `flatpak-auto`)**:
  - 支持 `variant: all | full | lite` 独立分发。
  - `aur-auto` 新增 `fcitx5-vinput-lite-bin` 软件包配置。
  - `flatpak-auto` 新增 `fcitx5-vinput-lite` 产品配置。

name: nix-cache

on:
  # Publish a fresh Cachix binary for each formal release tag.
  # Do not rebuild on every main push; ordinary app commits do not need a
  # cache refresh, and flake-only bumps can still use workflow_dispatch.
  push:
    tags:
      - 'v*'
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: nix-cache-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  cachix:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6

      - uses: cachix/install-nix-action@v31
        with:
          nix_path: nixpkgs=channel:nixos-unstable
          extra_nix_config: |
            experimental-features = nix-command flakes

      - uses: cachix/cachix-action@v17
        with:
          name: fcitx5-vinput
          authToken: ${{ secrets.CACHIX_AUTH_TOKEN }}

      - name: Build full and lite packages and push to Cachix
        run: |
          nix build .#fcitx5-vinput --no-link
          nix build .#fcitx5-vinput-lite --no-link

      - name: Verify lite runtime closure excludes local ASR dependencies
        run: |
          if nix path-info --recursive .#fcitx5-vinput-lite | grep -Ei '(openfst|onnxruntime|sherpa-onnx|kaldi|sentencepiece)'; then
            echo "Lite runtime closure contains a local ASR dependency." >&2
            exit 1
          fi

content.text:
**Nix 缓存（Cachix）本身不需要做任何配置修改，且已经完全适配了！**

以下是它的工作机制与原因说明：

---

### 一、为什么 Cachix 缓存无需修改配置？

1. **共用同一个 Cachix 空间与公钥**：
   - 我们的 Cachix 缓存空间是 `fcitx5-vinput`（地址：`https://fcitx5-vinput.cachix.org`，公钥：`fcitx5-vinput.cachix.org-1:XpX3AA...`）。
   - 在同一个 Cachix 仓库下，**可以同时容纳同一个项目的任意多个衍生包**（包括 `fcitx5-vinput` 完整版和 `fcitx5-vinput-lite` 轻量版），两者的二进制哈希（Nix Store Path）互相独立存储，完全不需要开新的 Cachix 空间。
2. **`flake.nix` 用户端零侵入**：
   - 用户在系统 `nixConfig` 里依然写相同的 `extra-substituters = [ "https://fcitx5-vinput.cachix.org" ]`。
   - 无论用户在配置里引用的是 `pkgs.fcitx5-vinput` 还是 `pkgs.fcitx5-vinput-lite`，Nix 都会自动从这个缓存空间里拉取对应的预编译二进制，**两边均能享受到秒级免编译下载**。

---

### 二、我们在工作流里已经做好的适配

在 `.github/workflows/nix-cache.yml` 中，我们已经将其升级为**双包自动推送**：

```yaml
- name: Build full and lite packages and push to Cachix
  run: |
    # 1. 编译完整版并推送到 Cachix
    nix build .#fcitx5-vinput --no-link

    # 2. 编译轻量版并推送到 Cachix
    nix build .#fcitx5-vinput-lite --no-link

- name: Verify lite runtime closure excludes local ASR dependencies
  run: |
    # 3. 校验 Lite 版的运行时闭包确保无任何 ONNX/Sherpa 依赖
    if nix path-info --recursive .#fcitx5-vinput-lite | grep -Ei '(openfst|onnxruntime|sherpa-onnx|kaldi|sentencepiece)'; then
      echo "Lite runtime closure contains a local ASR dependency." >&2
      exit 1
    fi
```

每次发版打 Tag 时，GitHub Actions 会自动把 **Full 和 Lite 的预编译二进制产物同时推送到 Cachix**。

---

### 三、用户端在 Nix 中的使用方式

用户在 NixOS / Home-Manager 中可以根据需要自由选用：

```nix
# 方式 A：完整版（默认，带本地 sherpa-onnx 离线推理）
i18n.inputMethod.fcitx5.addons = [
  inputs.fcitx5-vinput.packages.${pkgs.system}.default
];

# 方式 B：轻量版（纯云端 ASR + LLM，体积小、无 ONNX 依赖）
i18n.inputMethod.fcitx5.addons = [
  inputs.fcitx5-vinput.packages.${pkgs.system}.fcitx5-vinput-lite
];
```

两种方式都会直接命中现有的 Cachix 缓存！

title: Settings
description: Capture device, gain, VAD, and other global settings.
---

## Concepts

Global settings control Vinput's base runtime environment, independent of ASR engine or scene selection.

Corresponding config:

```json
{
  "global": {
    "default_language": "en",
    "capture_device": "rnnoise_source",
    "duck_output_while_recording": false,
    "duck_output_volume": 0.25
  },
  "asr": {
    "normalize_audio": true,
    "input_gain": 5.0,
    "vad": {
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

## Capture device

Select the microphone input source. Vinput captures audio via PipeWire — this lists available capture devices on your system.

### GUI

In Vinput GUI, select the device on the **Control** page.

### CLI

```bash
vinput device list              # List available capture devices
vinput device use <name>        # Set active device
```

## Input gain

`input_gain` controls the recording volume multiplier. Increase this if your microphone is too quiet for good recognition.

```bash
vinput config set /asr/input_gain 5.0
```

## Audio normalization

`normalize_audio` normalizes the audio signal for more consistent volume levels.

```bash
vinput config set /asr/normalize_audio true
```

## VAD (Voice Activity Detection)

VAD detects whether someone is speaking. When enabled, silent segments are filtered out automatically, reducing unnecessary recognition attempts.

```bash
vinput config set /asr/vad/enabled true
```

Optional VAD knobs (offline local ASR only):


[73 more lines in file. Use offset=71 to continue.]

```bash
vinput config set /asr/vad/threshold 0.45
vinput config set /asr/vad/min_speech_duration 0.15
vinput config set /asr/vad/speech_pad_ms 300
```

## Capture warm path (privacy)

To reduce leading-word dropout after idle, the daemon may keep a **connected but inactive** PipeWire capture stream for a short grace period after you stop recording. While inactive:

- audio is **not** copied into recognition buffers
- `recording` is false
- the stream is destroyed after the idle grace (default **15s**)

This is **not** always-on listening. Environment overrides (user unit):

```bash
# Disable stream reuse (legacy destroy/create every start)
Environment=VINPUT_CAPTURE_REUSE=0

# Idle destroy grace in milliseconds (0 = destroy immediately after stop)
REDACTED
```

Verify on your machine:

1. Record once, then wait past the grace period without recording.
2. Confirm daemon logs: `capture idle grace expired; destroying reusable stream`.
3. Optionally inspect PipeWire (`pw-top` / desktop mic indicator) — after grace, Vinput should not hold an active capture stream.
4. Cold-start metrics: `./scripts/bench-capture-cold-start.sh --since "1 hour ago"` (requires `VINPUT_DEBUG=1`).

## Reduce output volume while recording

When `duck_output_while_recording` is enabled, Vinput lowers the system output
volume while recording and restores it afterwards. This helps when you use
speakers and a microphone at the same time — for example listening to music
while dictating — so that speaker sound leaking into the microphone does not
degrade recognition.

`duck_output_volume` is the fraction of the current output volume kept while
recording (`0.25` keeps 25%). It is clamped to the `0.0`–`1.0` range. This
feature is off by default.

Volume is adjusted through WirePlumber (`wpctl`), so it matches the system
volume and is fully restored afterwards. If WirePlumber is not available (for
example inside some sandboxes), the feature is silently skipped.

```bash
vinput config set /global/duck_output_while_recording true
vinput config set /global/duck_output_volume 0.25
```

Both options are also available on the **Control** page in Vinput GUI, under the
**Audio** section.

## Language

`default_language` sets the default language, affecting UI display and some model behavior.

```bash
vinput config set /global/default_language zh
```

## General CLI

```bash
vinput config get <JSON Pointer>        # Read any config value
vinput config set <JSON Pointer> <val>  # Write any config value
vinput config edit core                 # Edit core config (config.json)
vinput config edit fcitx                # Edit Fcitx addon config (vinput.conf)
vinput daemon restart                   # Restart daemon to apply changes
```

## Streaming Display Width

`MaxStreamingDisplayWidth` controls the maximum visual column width of the live streaming recognition preview in the Fcitx5 preedit tooltip. When streaming recognition text exceeds this width, earlier words are automatically folded into `Head...Tail` to keep the floating input window within screen bounds. Set to `0` to disable folding. Configurable via Fcitx5 Configuration GUI or in `~/.config/fcitx5/conf/vinput.conf`:


`duck_output_volume` 表示录音期间保留的音量比例（`0.25` 表示保留当前音量的 25%），取值会被限制在 `0.0`–`1.0` 之间。该功能默认关闭。

音量通过 WirePlumber（`wpctl`）调节，因此与系统音量一致并在结束后完整恢复。若系统上没有 WirePlumber（例如某些沙箱环境），该功能会被静默跳过。

```bash
vinput config set /global/duck_output_while_recording true
vinput config set /global/duck_output_volume 0.25
```

# NAME
vinput-config - Configuration format and options for fcitx5-vinput

# DESCRIPTION
**fcitx5-vinput** uses two configuration files:

1. *~/.config/vinput/config.json* — Core configuration for audio capture, ASR engines, LLM providers, and postprocessing scenes.
2. *~/.config/fcitx5/conf/vinput.conf* — Fcitx5 addon configuration for keybindings and UI settings.

# CONFIG.JSON STRUCTURE

The core configuration file is JSON-formatted with four top-level sections: **global**, **asr**, **llm**, and **scenes**.

## GLOBAL SECTION
Controls runtime audio environment and capture settings.

```json
"global": {
  "default_language": "en",
  "capture_device": "default",
  "duck_output_while_recording": false,
  "duck_output_volume": 0.25
}
```

**default_language** (*string*)
:   Default UI/model language code (e.g. `"en"`, `"zh"`).

**capture_device** (*string*)
:   PipeWire capture node name, or `"default"`.

**duck_output_while_recording** (*boolean*)
:   Whether to lower system audio volume via WirePlumber while recording.

**duck_output_volume** (*float*, `0.0` - `1.0`)
:   Target volume fraction when ducking is active (`0.25` = 25% original volume).

## ASR SECTION
Configures offline and cloud speech recognition engines.

```json
"asr": {
  "active_provider": "sherpa-onnx",
  "normalize_audio": true,
  "input_gain": 1.0,
  "vad": {
    "enabled": true,
    "threshold": 0.5,
    "min_speech_duration": 0.15,
    "speech_pad_ms": 300
  },
  "providers": [ ... ]
}
```

**active_provider** (*string*)
:   ID of the active ASR provider. Use `"sherpa-onnx"` for the offline local engine.

**normalize_audio** (*boolean*)
:   Normalize input audio waveforms before recognition.

**input_gain** (*float*)
:   Software recording volume multiplier.

**vad.enabled** (*boolean*)
:   Enable Voice Activity Detection to drop leading and trailing silence.

## LLM SECTION
Defines OpenAI-compatible API endpoints.

```json
"llm": {
  "providers": [
    {
      "id": "groq",
      "base_url": "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1",
      "api_key": "YOUR_API_KEY",
      "extra_body": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

## SCENES SECTION
Defines prompt templates and candidate counts for text rewriting.

```json
"scenes": {
  "active_scene": "__raw__",
  "definitions": [
    {
      "id": "__raw__",

[34 more lines in file. Use offset=101 to continue.]

"candidate_count": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "default",
      "label": "Default Polish",
      "prompt": "Fix spelling and punctuation while keeping original meaning.",
      "provider_id": "groq",
      "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
      "context_lines": 3,
      "candidate_count": 5
    }
  ]
}
```

**active_scene** (*string*)
:   ID of the currently selected scene. `__raw__` skips LLM post-processing.

**context_lines** (*integer*)
:   Number of preceding input lines sent to the LLM as conversational context.

# FILES
*~/.config/vinput/config.json*
:   User core configuration file.

*~/.config/fcitx5/conf/vinput.conf*
:   User Fcitx5 addon configuration file.

*~/.var/app/org.fcitx.Fcitx5/config/vinput/config.json*
:   Configuration path when running inside Flatpak.

# SEE ALSO
**vinput**(1), **vinput-daemon**(1), **fcitx5**(1)

# 名称
vinput-config - fcitx5-vinput 配置文件格式与选项说明

# 描述
**fcitx5-vinput** 使用两份主要的配置文件：

1. *~/.config/vinput/config.json* — 核心配置，涵盖音频采集、ASR 引擎、LLM 服务商及后处理场景。
2. *~/.config/fcitx5/conf/vinput.conf* — Fcitx5 插件配置，涵盖快捷键及界面显示设置。

# CONFIG.JSON 结构

核心配置文件采用 JSON 格式，主要包含四个顶级字段：**global**、**asr**、**llm** 与 **scenes**。

## GLOBAL 全局配置
控制底层音频环境与录音行为。

```json
"global": {
  "default_language": "zh",
  "capture_device": "default",
  "duck_output_while_recording": false,
  "duck_output_volume": 0.25
}
```

**default_language** (*字符串*)
:   默认语言代码（例如 `"zh"`, `"en"`）。

**capture_device** (*字符串*)
:   PipeWire 音频采集节点名称，或 `"default"` 使用系统默认输入设备。

**duck_output_while_recording** (*布尔值*)
:   是否在录音时通过 WirePlumber 自动降低系统扬声器音量。

**duck_output_volume** (*浮点数*, `0.0` - `1.0`)
:   降低音量时的目标音量比例（`0.25` 表示降至原音量的 25%）。

## ASR 语音识别配置
配置本地与云端语音识别引擎。

```json
"asr": {
  "active_provider": "sherpa-onnx",
  "normalize_audio": true,
  "input_gain": 1.0,
  "vad": {
    "enabled": true,
    "threshold": 0.5,
    "min_speech_duration": 0.15,
    "speech_pad_ms": 300
  },
  "providers": [ ... ]
}
```

**active_provider** (*字符串*)
:   当前激活的 ASR 服务商 ID。本地离线识别使用 `"sherpa-onnx"`。

**normalize_audio** (*布尔值*)
:   是否在识别前对输入音频波形进行归一化。

**input_gain** (*浮点数*)
:   软件录音增益倍数。

**vad.enabled** (*布尔值*)
:   是否启用静音检测，自动过滤首尾无效静音。

## LLM 服务商配置
定义 OpenAI 兼容的 API 端点。

```json
"llm": {
  "providers": [
    {
      "id": "groq",
      "base_url": "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1",
      "api_key": "YOUR_API_KEY",
      "extra_body": {}
    }
  ]
}
```

## SCENES 场景后处理配置
定义用于文字润色、错别字修正或翻译的提示词模板与候选词配置。

```json
"scenes": {
  "active_scene": "__raw__",
  "definitions": [
    {
      "id": "__raw__",
      "candidate_count": 0
    },
    {
      "id": "default",
      "label": "默认润色",
      "prompt": "修正拼写与标点，保持原意不变。",
      "provider_id": "groq",
      "model": "llama-3.3-70b-versatile",
      "context_lines": 3,
      "candidate_count": 5
    }
  ]
}
```

**active_scene** (*字符串*)
:   当前激活的场景 ID。`__raw__` 表示跳过 LLM 后处理，直接输出 ASR 原始文本。

**context_lines** (*整数*)
:   发送给 LLM 的历史上下文行数（`0` 表示不附带上下文）。

content.text:
当然记得！我们前面梳理出 GUI 界面存在的 **三大核心交互与职责问题**：

---

### 一、UI 问题核心要点回顾

#### 1. 控制台（`ControlPage`）放错了“删除”按钮
- **问题**：`ControlPage` 目前包含了一个红色的 `Remove`（移除）按钮。
- **目标**：控制台只做**日常运行与参数配置**，应该只保留 **【设为当前 (Activate)】** 和 **【参数设置 (Edit)】**，将破坏性的【移除 (Remove)】彻底从控制台移除。

#### 2. 资源中心（`ResourcePage`）“只管安装、缺少卸载”
- **问题**：资源中心只有 `Install`（安装）按钮，一旦安装了 Provider 脚本或 Adapter，用户在资源中心根本找不到卸载入口。
- **目标**：在 `ASR Providers` 和 `LLM Adapters` 标签页，完整补齐 **【卸载/移除 (Remove)】** 功能。

#### 3. LLM 适配器（`LLM Adapter`）生命周期控制与状态展示缺失
- **问题**：CLI 拥有完整的 `vinput adapter start/stop` 命令，但 GUI 界面缺少直观的**启动 (Start)、停止 (Stop) 以及进程运行状态指示灯（Running / Stopped）**，导致用户在图形界面无法便捷启停本地 LLM 适配器。

---

我们可以把这一套 UI 交互重构作为接下来的专项任务来规划和设计。你想先从哪个页面的具体布局开始梳理？
先发 issue 以及 zsh 补全还是有问题 拆分成两个issue ，先不考虑后续开发，只记录问题

arguments.command:
gh issue create \
  --title "refactor(gui): clean up page responsibilities and add adapter lifecycle controls" \
  --body "### Problem & Context

Currently, the Qt GUI (\`vinput-gui\`) has misaligned page responsibilities and missing resource lifecycle controls:

1. **ControlPage carries destructive removal**:
   - The \`ControlPage\` currently contains a \`Remove\` button for ASR providers.
   - A control panel should focus strictly on daily operations: **Activate** (set as active engine) and **Edit** (configure API parameters). Destructive uninstallation belongs in the resource catalog.

2. **ResourcePage lacks uninstallation**:
   - In \`ResourcePage\`, both the \`ASR Providers\` and \`LLM Adapters\` tabs only have an \`Install\` button.
   - Once a provider script or adapter is installed, users cannot uninstall/remove it from the resource center.

3. **LLM Adapter process lifecycle missing in GUI**:
   - While the CLI supports \`vinput adapter start <id>\` and \`vinput adapter stop <id>\`, the GUI lacks intuitive controls to start/stop local adapter processes and view their live running status (\`Running\` / \`Stopped\`).

### Proposed Solution

1. **ControlPage**: Remove the \`Remove\` button; keep only \`Activate\` and \`Edit\`.
2. **ResourcePage**: Add \`Remove\` (uninstall) buttons for both \`ASR Providers\` and \`LLM Adapters\` tabs.
3. **Adapter Lifecycle**: Add start/stop buttons and visual status indicators (Running/Stopped) for installed adapters."

content.thinking: Problem identified: Zsh auto-completion for `vinput` malfunctions in interactive environments. Investigation will begin focusing on the header format and function signatures within the data files to understand why the completion isn't working as expected.

arguments.command:
gh issue create \
  --title "fix(completions): investigate and fix zsh auto-completion in interactive environments" \
  --body "### Problem Description

Auto-completion for \`vinput\` does not trigger or complete subcommands/options when pressing \`<TAB>\` in interactive Zsh environments.

### Areas to Investigate

1. **Zsh \`_arguments\` and state-machine execution**:
   - Verify whether the \`_vinput\` function properly registers and executes inside Zsh's native completion widget context.
   - Test compatibility across plain Zsh, Oh-My-Zsh, and custom completion configurations.

2. **autoload and fpath registration**:
   - Confirm file naming (\`_vinput\`), header declaration (\`#compdef vinput\`), and installation destination (\`/usr/share/zsh/site-functions/_vinput\`).
   - Investigate \`~/.zcompdump\` cache invalidation behavior when installing or updating completions.

3. **Fallback & Subcommand Resolution**:
   - Ensure nested subcommands (\`model\`, \`provider\`, \`daemon\`, \`recording\`, etc.) and their flags are reliably completed without relying on uninitialized state."
